content.overview: Without prejudice to section 143, section 378ZG requires the auditor of a Producer Company to report on specified additional matters: debts due and bad debts; verification of cash balance and securities; assets and liabilities; transactions that appear contrary to Chapter XXIA; loans to directors; donations or subscriptions; and any other matter the auditor considers necessary.
content.glance: Section 378ZG adds seven specified reporting matters to the audit of a Producer Company, without prejudice to section 143.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZG (Duties of auditor under this Chapter). Without prejudice to section 143, the auditor must report on the additional matters specified by the section: debts due and bad debts; verification of cash balance and securities; details of assets and liabilities; transactions appearing contrary to Chapter XXIA; loans given by the Producer Company to directors; donations or subscriptions made by the company; and any other matter considered necessary by the auditor. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Statutory relationship
sections.body: The additional reporting duties under section 378ZG apply without prejudice to the provisions contained in section 143.

sections.heading: Additional matters (a)–(c)
sections.body: The auditor reports the amount of debts due with particulars of bad debts, verifies cash balance and securities, and reports details of assets and liabilities.

sections.heading: Additional matters (d)–(f)
sections.body: The auditor reports transactions that appear contrary to Chapter XXIA, loans given by the Producer Company to directors, and donations or subscriptions given by the Producer Company.

sections.heading: Other matter
sections.body: The auditor also reports any other matter considered necessary by the auditor.

examples.title: Preparing an audit report checklist
examples.body: Use section 378ZG as an additional checklist alongside section 143: debts and bad debts, cash/securities, assets/liabilities, apparently contrary transactions, loans to directors, donations/subscriptions and other matters the auditor considers necessary.

hypotheticals.question: An auditor's report on a Producer Company omits loans made by the company to directors and donations/subscriptions. Which section 378ZG items should be checked?
hypotheticals.analysis: Section 378ZG expressly lists loans given by the Producer Company to directors and donations or subscriptions given by the company as additional reporting matters. The audit also remains subject to section 143; the section's list is not limited to those two matters.

distinctions.title: General audit duties and additional Chapter XXIA reporting
distinctions.left: Section 143 contains the broader audit provisions referenced by section 378ZG.
distinctions.right: Section 378ZG adds specified matters that the auditor must report for a Producer Company, without prejudice to section 143.

rows.right: Debts/bad debts, cash/securities, assets/liabilities, contrary transactions, director loans and donations/subscriptions

misconceptions.correction: The section expressly operates without prejudice to section 143.

misconceptions.trap: Omitting director loans or donations/subscriptions from the additional report.
misconceptions.correction: Both are expressly listed additional matters.

misconceptions.trap: Treating the listed items as exhaustive despite the final clause.
misconceptions.correction: The auditor must also report any other matter considered necessary by the auditor.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378zg do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: The auditor of a Producer Company has the duties the section states, including reporting on the books, the balance sheet and the profit and loss account, and on the matters the section lists.
